name: browser-automation-studio.learning-read
purpose: Read comparable agent effort and outcome cohorts without inventing baselines or treating absent measurements as zero.
assumptions: lib.vrooli_memory.compare_outcomes owns cohort collection and validity; the consumer projects the seven BAS rows with cohort_limit=1.
invariants: One bounded envelope on every path
Missing measurements remain unknown; test attempts do not establish an operator baseline
Read-only; never exercise write bindings to improve their condition

signals.rows: Rows with full cohort identities; multiple cohorts require operation/context selectors and remain unreliable until narrowed.
signals.reliability: Shared Memory reliability, scan counters, and cohort truncation; status and resolved inputs are preserved.

outputs.evidence: Typed Memory and binding-condition sensor references

fixtures.note: Empty or unexercised samples preserve the shared partial status and unreliable rows.
